name: Scenario 1 - Google My Business Review Routing (Make.com)
description: Webhook/polling blueprint stub for routing new Google My Business reviews to Claude-driven workflows.

modules.description: Receives a new review event payload from Make.com (webhook).
Validates and normalizes the review payload.
Calls the shared routing core (Claude classification + action plan).
Routes to downstream modules: leadership alert, draft generation, approvals, posting.
Fallback module that alerts senior leadership when any step fails.
